first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The bald man in the left foreground with their back to the camera, with broad, thick shoulders and back, light-colored skin with broad red markings, and brown leather protective gear.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The short-haired person astride the saddle on Animal A's back, wearing a light gray-blue top and dark pants.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The large gray-brown quadruped in the right midground, with thick curved horns, a long tail, golden head and back armor, and a saddle.

entities.name: Dark Red Tree Canopy
entities.identification: The dark red and pink clusters of leaves at the top of the image and the dark branching limbs among them.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The spear extending diagonally toward the image's upper right beside Person A, with a narrow, elongated silver tip and a long, hanging dark red cloth.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The long-handled axe on Person A's back near the image-right side, with a broad silver-gray axe head and a long brown handle.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: The slender bow partially exposed behind Person A's head and shoulders, with dark and light wrapping patterns on its upper section and an attached thin diagonal string.

entities.name: Stone-Framed Wooden-Stake Gate
entities.identification: The dark green-gray gate frame and vertical row of pointed orange-brown wooden stakes in the left background, partially occluded by Person A.

entities.name: Gray Stone Wall
entities.identification: The gray stone wall from the center to the right background, with a near-black doorway-like area in the center.

entities.name: Gnarled Vines on the Wall
entities.identification: The thick light gray-brown roots, thin vines, and clusters of green leaves winding and hanging along the Gray Stone Wall.

entities.name: Courtyard Stone-Paved Ground
entities.identification: The lower area of irregular blue-gray-green stone slabs and gravel, with a winding red-brown strip-like band in the midground.

entities.name: Ground Moss
entities.identification: The green clumps of grass, low moss-like cover, and a few broad leaves in the gaps between stones and on the midground ground.

entities.name: Courtyard Fungal Clusters
entities.identification: The clusters of red-orange umbrella-shaped fungi in the lower central courtyard, interspersed with smaller yellow-green caps.

entities.name: Weapon D
entities.identification: The elongated silver-gray curved blade slanting across Person A's back, with its dark brown wrapped grip near the back of the neck.

Person A wears brown leather protective gear with straps and dark fur-like edging, and metallic rivets and fasteners are visible on the horizontal belt across the lower back.
At frame 0, Person C has short hair and wears a light gray-blue top and dark pants, with a dark belt at the waist; their torso is upright, with both hands near the front of the body.

At frame 0, Animal A is a large gray-brown quadruped with thick curved horns on both sides of its head, golden armor plates covering its head and back, a saddle, and a long tail; its body faces image-right, and its tail extends toward image-left.

At frame 0, Animal A is a large gray-brown quadruped with dark stripes in its fur and darker lower legs; its face has a light-colored muzzle, blue eyes, and exposed fangs. The thick horns on both sides of its head curve outward, with the tips curving upward. The golden face armor has multiple layered ridges, the golden back armor forms a continuous series of pointed plates, the side of the saddle has golden curved decorative plates, the side of the body has dark straps, and a dark looped strap hangs below the muzzle. Its body faces image-right, and its long tail extends toward image-left.
At frame 0, the Dark Red Tree Canopy has the following appearance: it consists of large clusters of dark red and pink leaves and dark branching limbs.

At frame 0, the Dark Red Tree Canopy consists of large, layered clusters of dark red and pink leaves and dark branching limbs; some leaf-cluster edges are brighter, thin branches interweave among them, and deep dark gaps are exposed between the branches and leaves.
At frame 0, Weapon A is a spear with a visible narrow, elongated silver tip and a slender shaft angled toward the image's upper right, with a long dark red cloth tied to the shaft.

At frame 0, Weapon A is a spear. At frame 0, Weapon B is a long-handled axe with a broad silver-gray axe head and a long, straight brown handle.
